description: think these are officially the best sugar cookies i’ve ever made!! just made some slight adjustments to the sugar cookie recipe on my website and it gives the softest, chewy sugar cookies with such a lovely caramel flavour from the browned butter. i did pair these with a buttercream frosting, but you could honestly just eat these on their own.  recipe link: https://www.thelunchbreak.co/recipes/brown-butter-sugar-cookies #baking #christmasbaking #cozyseason #sugarcookies #sugarcookie
